newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Brokerage Group chief to retire.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Brokerage Group chief to retire.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Sherif Nada, head of the institutional brokerage unit Fidelity Brokerage Group (FBG), will retire on August 1.
Succeeding Nada, 55, will be Kenneth Rathgeber, 49, who is currently acting president of Fidelity Brokerage Services, the United Kingdom-based brokerage unit that is part of FBG.

Rathberger will also succeed Nada on Fidelity's operating committee. Nada will continue as a senior vice president of Fidelity's parent company, FMR Corp, in a strategic role reporting to Gary Burkhead, vice chairman of FMR Corp and chief executive officer of Fidelity Institutional Group.
